name: Constant Troyon

summary.text: Constant Troyon was a French painter of the Barbizon school. In the early part of his career, he painted mostly landscapes.

19913081: Road in the Woods is a 19th-century painting by French painter Constant Troyon. Done in oil on canvas, the work depicts two dirt roads heading through a wooded area.
